name: Shenzhen Bsc Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Bsc Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, production and sales of precision functional parts and intelligent automation equipment products. The company offers precision functional, structural, optical, and new energy; precision module, which includes camera module, camera module protective cover, universal swivel base, health monitoring headband, and crystal magnetic base; and intelligent automation equipment such as AGV automatic handling system, lens integrated automatic assembly machine, lens bracket five-axis dispensing equipment, fully automatic graphite laminating line, fully automatic module assembly line, and shrapnel metal laser welding machine. …
